summary: Admit one static named conformance identity without adding it to automatic witness search.
requires: resolve nominal type and Trait
check module-local unique name
validate one coherent witness body
exclude from automatic search
publish deterministic evidence identity
decision_procedure: resolve nominal type and Trait
check module-local unique name
validate one coherent witness body
exclude from automatic search
publish deterministic evidence identity
termination_metric: finite descriptor/tree size and finite candidate set
evaluation_order: preconditions -> normalization -> ordered decision procedure -> diagnostic

summary: Parse the bounded Align? Width language and seal one deterministic interpolation padding plan before HIR.
requires: the scanner has isolated one braced INTERPOLATION_FORMAT_TEXT token
the raw token matches optional < > ^ followed by canonical decimal width 1 through 1000000
preconditions: require braced interpolation before invoking this predicate
preserve the raw token without whitespace normalization
normalization: map omitted alignment to LEFT, < to LEFT, > to RIGHT and ^ to CENTER; parse width as canonical base-10 integer
decision_procedure: reject an empty token with EMPTY_FORMAT
reject characters outside optional < > ^ and ASCII decimal digits with INVALID_GRAMMAR
reject a multi-digit width beginning with zero with WIDTH_LEADING_ZERO
reject width outside 1 through 1000000 with WIDTH_OUT_OF_RANGE
emit FORMAT_SPEC_V1 with U+0020 fill, Unicode-scalar minimum width, no truncation and extra center remainder on the right
termination_metric: one finite scanner token and one bounded decimal parse
evaluation_order: braced parser gate -> empty -> grammar -> leading zero -> range -> HIR plan

summary: Normalize one @scope modifier set and seal its cancellation-observation plan before typed HIR.
requires: preserve the complete CST modifier list including duplicates
resolve the nearest cancellation-aware execution context
resolve whether an active parent shield exists
normalization: emit modifiers in isolated then cancellable-or-shielded order; omitted cancellation mode becomes INHERIT
decision_procedure: reject the first duplicate modifier in source order
reject cancellable together with shielded on one scope
reject explicit cancellable inside an active parent shield
reject cancellable or shielded without a cancellation-aware execution context
emit INHERIT, OBSERVE, or DEFER_TO_OUTERMOST_SHIELD_EXIT with exact cleanup and failure-precedence laws
termination_metric: one finite modifier list plus one finite lexical parent chain
evaluation_order: parse -> duplicate -> same-scope conflict -> parent-shield conflict -> context -> plan

summary: Admit strong Eq/Ord only for one homogeneous Self domain or one compiler/Prelude-sealed bilateral family; product checker NOT_RUN.
requires: Eq denotes strong reflexive symmetric transitive equality and Ord denotes a total order whose zero agrees with Eq
intrinsic-reserved normalized pairs bypass conformance lookup
a user or language-derived strong comparison normalizes Rhs to exact Self
a heterogeneous family is compiler/Prelude sealed and owns both oriented witnesses plus one normalization domain
Ord bilateral rows prove reverse-sign and zero/equality agreement
selection remains left-owner DIRECT_GLOBAL with zero conversion, fallback or runtime lookup
preconditions: Trait and normalized operand types are resolved
the declaring owner or sealed family evidence is bound
normalization: normalize aliases and type arguments, preserve nominal identity, form the ordered operand key and, only for a sealed family, the sorted unordered pair key
decision_procedure: if the normalized pair is intrinsic-reserved return BYPASS_CONFORMANCE
reject a noneligible strong comparison profile
for user or language-derived evidence require normalized Rhs == Self and, for user evidence, the declaring owner == Self
for heterogeneous evidence require compiler/Prelude authority, a family ID, both oriented witnesses and one normalization-domain ID
require Eq total Boolean reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity
for Ord additionally require totality, trichotomy, transitivity, antisymmetry, reverse-sign and zero iff Eq
seal the witness and optional family identity before canonical HIR; runtime relookup count remains zero
termination_metric: one normalized pair, one finite family row and a closed Boolean law vector
evaluation_order: malformed or unresolved Trait head -> intrinsic reservation -> strong-profile and Self-domain admission -> bilateral family closure -> ordinary locality/overlap/witness selection

summary: Bind supports auto/by auto to one exact core or Prelude policy row and finite input proof before canonical HIR; product checker NOT_RUN.
requires: supports auto is an assertion on a core or Prelude Trait and does not create a policy
one exact registry row exists for normalized TraitId and PolicyVersion
policy ID, digest, input predicate and algorithm identity match the row
the normalized component graph is finite and evaluated with memoized identity-subject pairs and cycle detection
extensions, providers, source/import order and runtime state contribute zero evidence
successful synthesis seals policy, conformance, witness and derivation identities before canonical HIR
preconditions: TraitId and target TypeId are normalized
declaration authority and PolicyVersion are known
normalization: sort unique component evidence IDs by Unicode scalar order and key the registry only by normalized TraitId plus PolicyVersion
decision_procedure: reject a user-owned Trait supports auto clause
select one exact row or emit CONFORMANCE_AUTO_POLICY_NOT_REGISTERED
require policy ID, digest and input predicate equality
for a Trait opt-in seal the registry binding without a target witness
for by auto require an admitted source target kind and finite component graph
run only the row's registered input predicate; unknown or disproved input rejects
reject any direct witness, extension, provider or runtime contribution
seal deterministic conformance, witness and derivation identities
termination_metric: finite registry of two rows plus unvisited (TypeId,ResponsibilityRuleId) pairs in one finite nominal graph
evaluation_order: owner -> exact registry row -> digest/predicate identity -> finite graph -> registered predicate -> noncanonical evidence fence -> HIR seal
